rationale: The project ran four generations without a written validation strategy. Phase 2 publishes a public MCP endpoint, which is a contract consumed by third-party clients that will never read release notes. Shipping that without a written strategy would repeat the intake-DNS failure at a larger blast radius.
principles: Production deploys only from main. cloudflare-pages-preview must pass as a required check before merge.
Nothing is done until verified against the live public domain. Local pass and merge are not completion.
Never weaken or delete an assertion to make a build pass. Update assertions deliberately as part of the change.
Run the full local suite after any shared-page or config edit, not the subset that looks related.
Public write paths fail closed. An unvalidated or unthrottled write path is not shippable.

environments.local: Static Next.js export plus bespoke node validators under scripts/. No test runner is installed by design.
environments.preview: Cloudflare Pages PR preview. May not expose all production secrets, so it cannot fully validate secret-dependent write paths.
environments.production: Cloudflare Pages from main, served at northvalleyintel.com and www.northvalleyintel.com.

cacheBustingRule.rule: Every production verification of a page or static asset must append a cache-busting query parameter.
cacheBustingRule.reason: Cloudflare serves with s-maxage=300, so for up to five minutes after deploy the bare URL can return the previous version and make a deploy check report a false result.
exempt: MCP JSON-RPC POST requests, which are not edge-cached

categories.passCriteria: All three exit zero. build must emit the static export including every route under test.

categories.appliesTo: intake, assessment teaser, workflow chat, MCP tools
categories.note: test:assessment-teaser and test:chat were omitted from an earlier gate list. Both are in scope. Any change to homepage or services content implicates test:assessment-teaser.

productionVerification.intakeFailClosed: POST https://northvalleyintel.com/api/client-intake with incomplete payload returns an error, never an acceptance.
productionVerification.intakeDelivery: One controlled submission with a real attachment, confirmed received privately with the attachment intact.
productionVerification.mcpWritePath: Live call with incomplete payload is rejected; live call containing credential-shaped values is rejected.

categories.passCriteria: Validators exit zero and each production check returns its stated result.

checks: tools/list returns exactly the published tool set
every tool carries a description and a valid input schema
annotations are present and readOnly/destructive hints are accurate
write tools declare and return a pending status
no tool response contains complete assessment report content

productionVerification.statelessHandshake: Drive the live production endpoint with sequential HTTP requests: initialize, then tools/list, then tools/call. Each is a separate connection hitting a fresh instance.
productionVerification.whyNotInMemory: An in-memory MCP client test uses one persistent connection and cannot surface a stateless-handshake failure. It will pass while production is broken. In-memory testing alone never satisfies this check.
productionVerification.methodDisallowed: GET /mcp returns 405. OPTIONS returns CORS headers.

categories.passCriteria: All checks pass locally and the sequential live sequence completes against production.

checks: fail closed on missing or malformed required fields
reject credential-shaped input (passwords, API keys, tokens, registrar logins)
trust invariant: no code path emits a confirmed state; write tools always return pending review
categories.note: Turnstile cannot run inside an agent client. The MCP write path substitutes honeypot plus shared secret plus a Cloudflare KV throttle. A write path without a durable throttle is not shippable.

productionVerification.throttle: Repeated live submissions past the window limit are rejected.
productionVerification.trustInvariant: Grep the built output for confirmed-state emission on write paths; confirm live responses return pending.

categories.passCriteria: Every check enforced in code, not only in copy, and each production check returns its stated result.

checks: source-website-assessment.json, llms.txt, robots.txt, sitemap.xml reflect current information architecture
FAQ structured data present and valid
no chatbot-first or autonomous-booking language on customer-facing pages
protocol, endpoint, and tool-schema detail confined to llms.txt and source-website-assessment.json
categories.passCriteria: Validator exits zero against local build and the live URLs serve the current content.

productionVerification.method: Fetch the live page cache-busted and assert on rendered content, not source.

categories.passCriteria: Each URL returns 200 and renders the expected content.

checks: cloudflare-pages-preview passed as a required status check before merge
production reflects the current main commit
any Pages custom domain reports active, not pending
categories.note: A custom domain attached but pending is a failed deployment check, not a warning. This is the failure mode that left intake.northvalleyintel.com unresolved for six weeks.
categories.passCriteria: All checks pass. A pending custom domain blocks phase exit.

severityPolicy.Critical: Must pass before merge. No deferral.
severityPolicy.High: Must pass, be explicitly accepted, or be explicitly deferred with a recorded exact next action.

secondRunPolicy.requirement: Validation Gate must pass twice with no code, test, strategy, or validator changes between clean passes. Any such change resets the count.
mustRerun: anything affected by changes since run 1
validations tied to unresolved High risks
all production and network-dependent checks, which are environment-sensitive by nature
secondRunPolicy.maySkip: Validations provably unaffected by changes since run 1, each with a recorded reason in the validation run.
secondRunPolicy.neverSkip: Production verification. It is non-deterministic and cache-sensitive.

knownLimitations: Preview cannot fully validate secret-dependent write paths, so the MCP write path requires a controlled production test.
assessment.northvalleyintel.com must be reachable from the Pages Function for teaser generation, including via the MCP path.
Resend sender-domain verification gates delivery to arbitrary customer addresses, which is precisely the traffic the MCP write path creates.
